review_text: Since high school, I've always walked by this shop, but unintentionally tried it today while waiting for something. I ordered just to pass the time, and never thought their butter bread toast was superb and the coffee really got my taste buds hooked for the first time. I found coffee that wasn't over-saturated with milk and whipped cream. With a heavy heart, I left it unfinished because I was running late for work hahaha.

Kopi lah Roti have been operating their business since 2007. They have free wifi and the shop offers a place that makes you feel grounded in the middle of a busy city. They have seats outside and it is not crowded. However, they don't have enough space for parking. Atmosphere: I haven't been into Singapore yet but the atmosphere of the place adorned with hanging flowers and other kinds reminded me of the Crazy Rich Asian movie. I hope that makes sense. If you visit the shop, you will also notice a portrait painting of what seemed like a regular day at the Singapore. Posters of a man preparing Kopi (the national drink of Singapore) can be seen outside and inside of the shop that reminded me the importance of the Kopitiam culture to Singapore. Food: It was my first Singaporean dining experience so I gave it 5 stars. I ordered Set B for my breakfast. It was a Teh with milk, soft boiled eggs and roti kaya toast. You can enjoy the food by dipping the kaya toast to kopi then eggs but I wanted to try something different and honestly, that was a wonderful experience for me and I really enjoyed it. Service: The service is excellent and their staffs are friendy.

I had a delightful experience at Kopi Lah Roti Davao's Jacinto extension branch. The Singaporean coffee stood out, impressing me with its rich flavors. While some meals were on the pricey side, the overall enjoyment and the quality of the coffee made it a worthwhile visit. The ambiance added to the experience, creating a memorable outing. If you appreciate excellent coffee, this place is worth trying despite the slightly higher prices for some dishes. I must mention, one letdown for me was the cramped space at Kopi Lah Roti Davao's Jacinto extension branch. Despite the enjoyable coffee and tasty meals, the limited space did affect the overall comfort. If you don't mind a cozy setting, the fantastic coffee and flavorsome dishes could still make it a worthwhile stop. Another factor to note is the absence of available parking at Kopi Lah Roti Davao's Jacinto extension branch, which added a bit of inconvenience to the overall experience. While the cramped space and limited parking might be drawbacks, the delightful coffee and delicious meals can make it a worthwhile choice for those willing to overlook these minor inconveniences.
